00061 void BEQBaseUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00062 {
00063     int filterLoops = UGen::getFilterLoops();
00064     int filterRemain = UGen::getFilterRemain();
00065     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00066     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00067     float newFreq = *(inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00068     float newControl = *(inputs[Control].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00069     float newGain = *(inputs[Gain].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00070     float y0;
00071     
00072 //  if(!initialised)
00073 //  {
00074 //      calculateCoeffs(newFreq, newControl, newGain, a0, a1, a2, b1, b2);
00075 //      currentFreq = newFreq;
00076 //      currentControl = newControl;
00077 //      currentGain = newGain;
00078 //      initialised = true;
00079 //  }
00080     
00081     LOCAL_DECLARE(double, y1);
00082     LOCAL_DECLARE(double, y2);
00083     LOCAL_DECLARE(double, a0);
00084     LOCAL_DECLARE(double, a1);
00085     LOCAL_DECLARE(double, a2);
00086     LOCAL_DECLARE(double, b1);
00087     LOCAL_DECLARE(double, b2);
00088     
00089     ugen_assert(newFreq > 0.f);
00090     ugen_assert(newFreq < (UGen::getSampleRate() * 0.5));
00091     
00092     if((currentFreq != newFreq) || (currentControl != newControl) || (currentGain != newGain))
00093     {       
00094         double oneOverFilterLoops = UGen::getReciprocalFilterLoops();
00095         
00096         if(faster_ == true) // faster but glitches during large, rapid changes
00097         {
00098             double next_a0, next_a1, next_a2, next_b1, next_b2;
00099             calculateCoeffs(newFreq, newControl, newGain, next_a0, next_a1, next_a2, next_b1, next_b2);
00100                         
00101             double a0_slope = (next_a0 - a0) * oneOverFilterLoops;
00102             double a1_slope = (next_a1 - a1) * oneOverFilterLoops;
00103             double a2_slope = (next_a2 - a2) * oneOverFilterLoops;
00104             double b1_slope = (next_b1 - b1) * oneOverFilterLoops;
00105             double b2_slope = (next_b2 - b2) * oneOverFilterLoops;
00106             
00107             while(filterLoops--)
00108             {
00109                 y0 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y1 + b2 * y2; 
00110                 *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y0 + a1 * y1 + a2 * y2);
00111                 
00112                 y2 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y0 + b2 * y1; 
00113                 *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y2 + a1 * y0 + a2 * y1);
00114                 
00115                 y1 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y2 + b2 * y0; 
00116                 *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y1 + a1 * y2 + a2 * y0);
00117                 
00118                 a0 += a0_slope;
00119                 a1 += a1_slope;
00120                 a2 += a2_slope;
00121                 b1 += b1_slope;
00122                 b2 += b2_slope;
00123             }
00124             
00125             a0 = next_a0;
00126             a1 = next_a1;
00127             a2 = next_a2;
00128             b1 = next_b1;
00129             b2 = next_b2;
00130         }
00131         else // more cpu intensive but cleaner for rapid changes
00132         {       
00133             double freqSlope    = (newFreq - currentFreq) * oneOverFilterLoops;
00134             double controlSlope = (newControl - currentControl) * oneOverFilterLoops;
00135             double gainSlope    = (newGain - currentGain) * oneOverFilterLoops;
00136             
00137             while(filterLoops--)
00138             {
00139                 calculateCoeffs(currentFreq, currentControl, currentGain, a0, a1, a2, b1, b2);
00140                 
00141                 y0 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y1 + b2 * y2; 
00142                 *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y0 + a1 * y1 + a2 * y2);
00143                 
00144                 y2 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y0 + b2 * y1; 
00145                 *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y2 + a1 * y0 + a2 * y1);
00146                 
00147                 y1 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y2 + b2 * y0; 
00148                 *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y1 + a1 * y2 + a2 * y0);
00149                 
00150                 currentFreq += freqSlope;
00151                 currentControl += controlSlope;
00152                 currentGain += gainSlope;
00153             }
00154             
00155             calculateCoeffs(newFreq, newControl, newGain, a0, a1, a2, b1, b2);
00156         }
00157         
00158         while(filterRemain--)
00159         {
00160             y0 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y1 + b2 * y2; 
00161             *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y0 + a1 * y1 + a2 * y2);
00162             
00163             y2 = y1; 
00164             y1 = y0;
00165         }
00166         
00167         currentFreq = newFreq;
00168         currentControl = newControl;
00169         currentGain = newGain;
00170         LOCAL_COPY(a0);
00171         LOCAL_COPY(a1);
00172         LOCAL_COPY(a2);
00173         LOCAL_COPY(b1);
00174         LOCAL_COPY(b2);
00175     }
00176     else
00177     {
00178         while(filterLoops--)
00179         {
00180             y0 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y1 + b2 * y2; 
00181             *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y0 + a1 * y1 + a2 * y2);
00182             
00183             y2 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y0 + b2 * y1; 
00184             *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y2 + a1 * y0 + a2 * y1);
00185             
00186             y1 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y2 + b2 * y0; 
00187             *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y1 + a1 * y2 + a2 * y0);
00188         }
00189         
00190         while(filterRemain--)
00191         {
00192             y0 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y1 + b2 * y2; 
00193             *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y0 + a1 * y1 + a2 * y2);
00194             
00195             y2 = y1; 
00196             y1 = y0;
00197         }
00198     }
00199     
00200     y1 = zap(y1);
00201     y2 = zap(y2);
00202     LOCAL_COPY(y1);
00203     LOCAL_COPY(y2);
00204 }

00226 void BLowPassUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float rq, const float gain, 
00227                                            double& a0, double& a1, double& a2, double& b1, double& b2)
00228 {
00229     (void)gain; // not used in BLowPass
00230     
00231     double w0 = twopi * (double)freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate(); 
00232     double cosw0 = cos(w0); 
00233     double i = 1.0 - cosw0; 
00234     double alpha = sin(w0) * 0.5 * (double)rq; 
00235     double b0rz = 1.0 / (1.0 + alpha); 
00236     a0 = i * 0.5 * b0rz; 
00237     a1 = i * b0rz; 
00238     a2 = a0; 
00239     b1 = cosw0 * 2.0 * b0rz; 
00240     b2 = (1.0 - alpha) * -b0rz; 
00241 }

00256     }

00289 void BHiPassUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float rq, const float gain,

00351 void BBandPassUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float bw, const float gain, 
00352                                             double& a0, double& a1, double& a2, double& b1, double& b2)
00353 {
00354     (void)gain; // not used in BBandPass
00355     
00356     double w0 = twopi * (double)freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate(); 
00357     double sinw0 = sin(w0);
00358     double alpha = sinw0 * (sinh((0.34657359027997 * (double)bw * w0) / sinw0));
00359     double b0rz = 1.0 / (1.0 + alpha); 
00360     a0 = alpha * b0rz; 
00361     a1 = 0.0;
00362     a2 = -a0; 
00363     b1 = cos(w0) * 2.0 * b0rz; 
00364     b2 = (1.0 - alpha) * -b0rz; 
00365 }

00395 void BBandStopUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float bw, const float gain, 
00396                                             double& a0, double& a1, double& a2, double& b1, double& b2)
00397 {
00398     (void)gain; // not used in BBandStop
00399     
00400     double w0 = twopi * (double)freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate(); 
00401     double sinw0 = sin(w0);
00402     double alpha = sinw0 * (sinh((0.34657359027997 * (double)bw * w0) / sinw0));
00403     double b0rz = 1.0 / (1.0 + alpha);  
00404     b1 = 2.0 * b0rz * cos(w0); 
00405     a0 = b0rz; 
00406     a1 = -b1;
00407     a2 = b0rz; 
00408     b2 = (1.0 - alpha) * -b0rz; 
00409 }

00440 void BPeakEQUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float rq, const float gain, 
00441                                             double& a0, double& a1, double& a2, double& b1, double& b2)
00442 {   
00443     double a = pow(10., (double)gain * 0.025);
00444     double w0 = twopi * (double)freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate(); 
00445     double alpha = sin(w0) * 0.5 * (double)rq;
00446     double alphaBy_a = alpha * a;
00447     double alphaOver_a = alpha / a;
00448     double b0rz = 1.0 / (1.0 + alphaOver_a);    
00449     b1 = 2.0 * b0rz * cos(w0); 
00450     a0 = (1.0 + alphaBy_a) * b0rz; 
00451     a1 = -b1;
00452     a2 = (1.0 - alphaBy_a) * b0rz; 
00453     b2 = (1.0 - alphaOver_a) * -b0rz; 
00454 }

00485 void BLowShelfUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float rs, const float gain, 
00486                                           double& a0, double& a1, double& a2, double& b1, double& b2)
00487 {   
00488     double a = pow(10., (double)gain * 0.025);
00489     double w0 = twopi * (double)freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate(); 
00490     double sinw0 = sin(w0);
00491     double cosw0 = cos(w0);
00492     double alpha = sinw0 * 0.5 * sqrt((a + (1.0/a)) * ((double)rs - 1.0) + 2.0);
00493     double aPlus1 = a + 1.0;
00494     double aMinus1 = a - 1.0;
00495     double i = aPlus1 * cosw0;
00496     double j = aMinus1 * cosw0;
00497     double k = 2.0 * sqrt(a) * alpha;
00498     double aPlus1Minusk = aPlus1 - k;
00499     double b0rz = 1.0 / (aPlus1 + j + k);   
00500     
00501     a0 = a * (aPlus1 - j + k) * b0rz;
00502     a1 = 2.0 * a * (aMinus1 - i) * b0rz;
00503     a2 = a * (aPlus1Minusk - j) * b0rz;
00504     b1 = 2.0 * (aMinus1 + i) * b0rz;
00505     b2 = (aPlus1Minusk + j) * -b0rz; 
00506 }
00507 
00508 BLowShelf::BLowShelf(UGen const& input, UGen const& freq, UGen const& rs, UGen const& gain) throw()
00509 {
00510     UGen inputs[] = { input, freq, rs, gain };
00511     const int numInputChannels = findMaxInputChannels(numElementsInArray(inputs), inputs);  
00512     initInternal(numInputChannels);
00513     
00514     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00515     {
00516         BEQBaseUGenInternal* filter = new BLowShelfUGenInternal(input, freq, rs, gain, false);
00517         filter->calculateCoeffs(freq.getValue(i), rs.getValue(i), gain.getValue(i));
00518         filter->initValue(input.getValue(i) * gain.getValue(i));
00519         internalUGens[i] = filter;
00520     }
00521 }

00537 void BHiShelfUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float rs, const float gain, 
00538                                             double& a0, double& a1, double& a2, double& b1, double& b2)
00539 {   
00540     double a = pow(10., (double)gain * 0.025);
00541     double w0 = twopi * (double)freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate(); 
00542     double sinw0 = sin(w0);
00543     double cosw0 = cos(w0);
00544     double alpha = sinw0 * 0.5 * sqrt((a + (1.0/a)) * ((double)rs - 1.0) + 2.0);
00545     double aPlus1 = a + 1.0;
00546     double aMinus1 = a - 1.0;
00547     double i = aPlus1 * cosw0;
00548     double j = aMinus1 * cosw0;
00549     double k = 2.0 * sqrt(a) * alpha;
00550     double aPlus1Minusk = aPlus1 - k;
00551     double b0rz = 1.0 / (aPlus1 - j + k);   
00552     
00553     a0 = a * (aPlus1 + j + k) * b0rz;
00554     a1 = -2.0 * a * (aMinus1 + i) * b0rz;
00555     a2 = a * (aPlus1Minusk + j) * b0rz;
00556     b1 = -2.0 * (aMinus1 - i) * b0rz;
00557     b2 = (aPlus1Minusk - j) * -b0rz; 
00558 }

00588 void BAllPassUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float rq, const float gain, 
00589                                            double& a0, double& a1, double& a2, double& b1, double& b2)
00590 {
00591     (void)gain; // not used in BAllPass
00592     
00593     double w0 = twopi * (double)freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate(); 
00594     double alpha = sin(w0) * 0.5 * (double)rq; 
00595     double b0rz = 1.0 / (1.0 + alpha);  
00596     b1 = 2.0 * b0rz * cos(w0); 
00597     a0 = (1.0 - alpha) * b0rz; 
00598     a1 = -b1;
00599     a2 = 1.0; 
00600     b2 = -a0; 
00601 }
